decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Manuel Estrada Pérez received the Medal of Francysk Skaryna from Belarus, while document d2 explicitly states he received the Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland from Finland; both claims are directly supported by the provided text despite the fallible prior suggesting uncertainty about the individual's existence.
